description: Central Environmental Authority - Amendment to order Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2211/51 dated 21.01.2021 Order Under Section 23 W (1) (a)
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of an existing order under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It specifically modifies regulations concerning packaging (sachets) and adds a new definition for "Registrar of Pesticides." This constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal amendments and compliance requirements, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a minister is named, the primary focus is on the regulatory change rather than the minister's appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
